attempts.summary: Set up passwordless SSH from node2 to node1, wrote a pull-based rsync sync script on node2 with a scoped NOPASSWD sudo rule for writing /etc/inventory/app.conf, and scheduled it via cron every 5 minutes (well inside the 15-minute requirement). Verified two independent end-to-end syncs (content and sha256 hash match) - one before and one after restarting both nodes. Performed the mandatory sequential node-restart protocol on node1 then node2, each with captured pre/post boot_id change, service health, and data/cron persistence proof.
